title: 火車車廂
question:
火車調車場要用 linked list 記錄一列火車的車廂順序（車頭不算）。一開始沒有車廂，每節車廂有一個不會重複的編號。有三種指令：
1 x：把車廂 x 接到火車的最後面
2 a x：把車廂 x 接在車廂 a 的後面（車廂 a 一定在火車上）
3 x：把車廂 x 拆下來（車廂 x 一定在火車上）
第一行輸入 N，接下來輸入 N 個指令。最後從第一節車廂開始，每節車廂的編號各輸出一行；沒有車廂就輸出 Empty!
用 array 的話，在中間插入或拆掉一節，後面的每一格都要搬；用 linked list 只要改幾個指標。

test_case.note: 9 插在 3 後面；拆掉 5；1 接在最後一節 7 的後面

en.title: Train Cars
en.question:
A rail yard keeps the order of the cars of a train in a linked list (the engine does not count). At first there are no cars. Each car has a number, and no two are the same. There are three commands:
1 x: put car x at the end of the train
2 a x: put car x right after car a (car a is always on the train)
3 x: take car x off (car x is always on the train)
First input N, then N commands. At the end, output the number of each car from the first one, each on its own line. If there are no cars, output Empty!
With an array, putting a car in the middle or taking one off means moving every item after it. With a linked list you only change a few pointers.

test_case.note: 9 goes after 3; 5 comes off; 1 goes after the last car 7
